steps.name: apply-stage20a-deterministic-trace-replay-recovery-v2
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=15c98b262cf3329e0736d629f681535b40358dd9; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f warnings.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage20/apply_stage20a_deterministic_trace_replay.py > /tmp/apply-stage20a-deterministic-trace-replay.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/apply-stage20a-deterministic-trace-replay.py; .venv/bin/python -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('tools/ml/climate_replay.py'); s=p.read_text(); s=s.replace('isinstance(expected, (int, float))','isinstance(expected, int | float)').replace('isinstance(actual, (int, float))','isinstance(actual, int | float)').replace('isinstance(expected, (list, tuple))','isinstance(expected, list | tuple)').replace('isinstance(actual, (list, tuple))','isinstance(actual, list | tuple)'); p.write_text(s)"; .venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_replay.py tests/test_climate_replay.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff format tools/ml/climate_replay.py tests/test_climate_replay.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-stage20a-deterministic-trace-replay-recovery-v2
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_climate_replay.py tests/test_climate_trace_io.py tests/test_climate_trace.py tests/test_climate_runtime.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff check tools/ml/climate_replay.py tests/test_climate_replay.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check tools/ml/climate_replay.py tests/test_climate_replay.py; .venv/bin/python -c "from tools.ml.climate_replay import counterfactual_climate_trace_ml, first_climate_trace_ndjson_replay_divergence, first_climate_trace_replay_divergence, replay_climate_trace_record; assert all(callable(x) for x in (counterfactual_climate_trace_ml, first_climate_trace_ndjson_replay_divergence, first_climate_trace_replay_divergence, replay_climate_trace_record))"; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-stage20a-recovery-v2
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -A; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -A; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Add deterministic climate trace replay'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'PUBLISHED_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
